items.title: Sections and vanishing of the first cohomology of powers of the ideal sheaf of the exceptional divisor
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that in the rational situation with the special fibre an effective Cartier divisor, the sections of every power of the ideal sheaf of the exceptional divisor are the corresponding power of the maximal ideal and the first cohomology of that power vanishes (statement lines 2487-2495). The proof (proof lines 2496-2531) computes the sections of the ideal sheaf, uses global generation for the vanishing statement, and runs an exact sequence induction with the kernel of the presentation of the ideal sheaf to identify the sections of all powers. H2: a complete standard computation in two steps.
